title: Construct a Binary Tree from Inorder and Postorder Traversals
problemStatement: Given the inorder traversal and postorder traversal of a binary tree containing unique values, reconstruct the original binary tree.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the inorder traversal. • The third line contains the postorder traversal.
output: • Print the reconstructed tree in the required traversal format.
